subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers, or keep env interpolation limited to config loading and dotenv handling?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes a shared config/path interpretation rule that can affect existing stored paths and plugin or workspace behavior.

options.title: Adopt shared path expansion
options.body: Expand known env placeholders in the shared path helpers, preserve a documented literal/unknown behavior, and require focused tests around skill install and resolver edge cases.

options.title: Limit expansion to config load
options.body: Keep path helpers literal and fix the configuration or dotenv interpolation layer so authored config paths are normalized before runtime callers receive them.

options.title: Defer to dotenv issue
options.body: Leave this issue open but block implementation until #38259 settles the broader env-expansion policy across config and provider keys.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared path expansion
recommendation.body: Expand known env placeholders in the shared path helpers, preserve a documented literal/unknown behavior, and require focused tests around skill install and resolver edge cases.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal is recent ownership of the shared path helper that would define the permanent semantics.
